props.text: Plot embedding stress
Plots live in fixed cards, split rows, compact grid cells, and narrow cards. They should start with valid bounds, keep controls usable, and draw hover overlays above surrounding content.
Ready: hover plots and use Fit All to check constrained plot behavior.
Fit All
Refresh Data

Table scrollbars should stay local to this split pane.
Wide split: line plot beside virtualized table
2D scatter should not collapse to a dot in a card.
Compact 2D scatter
3D scatter should keep orbit controls, scalar bar, and orientation axes inside the panel.
Compact 3D scatter
Cell labels and hover readout should not cover unrelated text.
Heatmap in a card
Toolbar and axes should remain usable in a short panel.
Histogram in a card
Horizontal labels should reserve enough room without shifting on scroll.
Bar chart in a card
Very short plots should still show data instead of an empty frame.
Tiny mixed plot
PASS TARGET: plot data is visible on first frame, plot controls stay inside cards, fit buttons work after embedding, and hover readouts draw above nearby text without deleting it.
